'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)|War In Afghanistan]]
**[[2021 Taliban offensive]]
***[[Panjshir resistance]]
****The [[Taliban]] claim to have recaptured three [[districts of Afghanistan|districts]] in [[Baghlan Province]] that had been taken by local [[militia]]s allied with [[Ahmad Massoud]] and [[Amrullah Saleh]]. Massoud and Saleh have established their resistance in the [[Panjshir Valley]]. [https://news.yahoo.com/taliban-claim-ve-retaken-three-132200593.html (Yahoo! News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/taliban-say-they-have-retaken-three-northern-districts-seized-by-afghan-militias-2021-08-23/ (Reuters)]
***The brother of deposed [[President of Afghanistan|president]] [[Ashraf Ghani]], [[Hashmat Ghani Ahmadzai]], says he accepts that the Taliban won the war but that he "will not join them" and also calls for the formation of an inclusive [[government of Afghanistan|government]] without [[Gulbuddin Hekmatyar]] and former president [[Hamid Karzai]], blaming both men for "ruining the country". [https://www.indiatoday.in/world/story/accept-taliban-takeover-wont-join-them-hashmat-ghani-ahmadzai-1844282-2021-08-23 (''India Today'')]
**[[Operation Allies Refuge]]
***A [[security guard]] is killed and three more people are wounded in a [[gunfight]] between an unknown gunman and [[Afghan forces]] at the north gate of [[Hamid Karzai International Airport|Kabul airport]]. [[German forces|German]] and [[American forces]] are also involved in the shooting. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/germany-says-firefight-involving-western-forces-erupts-kabul-airport-2021-08-23/ (Reuters)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[2021 Daraa clashes]]
***[[Syrian Army]] troops and pro-[[Iran]]ian militias launch a major ground assault on a rebel-held enclave in the city of [[Daraa]]. Rebel forces say that they have repulsed the attack from the western side of the enclave. [[State media]] says that the army was preparing to end a "state of lawlessness and chaos" and "reimpose army control" in the city. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/syrian-army-pro-iranian-militias-attack-rebel-enclave-southern-city-2021-08-23/ (Reuters)]
*[[Tigray War]]
**The [[U.S. Department of Treasury]] sanctions the [[Chief of Staff of the Armed Forces (Eritrea)|chief of staff]] of the [[Eritrean Military|Eritrean Defense Forces]] [[Filipos Woldeyohannes]], accusing him of leading his troops to [[War crimes in the Tigray War|commit multiple war crimes]], including rapes, executions, massacres, looting, torture and purposely shooting civilians. The Department also called for the "immediate withdrawal of Eritrean troops" from Tigray. [https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2021/8/23/us-sanctions-eritrean-general-over-rights-abuses-in-ethiopia (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2021 California wildfires]]
**Around 400 homes are destroyed in the [[Caldor Fire]] in [[El Dorado County, California|El Dorado County]], [[California]]. Additionally, [[U.S. Route 50 in California|U.S. Route 50]] remains closed in the area. [https://www.sacbee.com/news/california/fires/article253680959.html (''The Sacramento Bee'')]
 
'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]] 
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in the Philippines]]
*****The [[Philippines|Philippine]] [[Food and Drug Administration (Philippines)|Food and Drug Administration]] issues an emergency use authorization for the [[Sputnik Light]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]], making the country the first in Asia to approve the [[Russia]]n single-dose vaccine. [https://www.rappler.com/nation/philippines-grants-emergency-approval-russia-sputnik-light-covid-19-vaccine (Rappler)]
****The Philippines reports a record 18,332 new cases of [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 1.85 million. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/news/08/23/21/philippines-logs-record-high-18332-new-covid-19-cases (ABS-CBN News and Current Affairs)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Sri Lanka]]
****[[Sri Lanka]] reports a record for the second consecutive day of 4,355 new cases of COVID-19, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 394,355. [https://www.dailynews.lk/2021/08/23/local/257438/sri-lanka-records-over-4000-covid-cases-second-consecutive-day (''Daily News'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Taiwan]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Taiwan]]
****[[Taiwan]] begins the "contested" rollout of its first domestically-produced [[MVC COVID-19 vaccine]], with [[President of the Republic of China|President]] [[Tsai Ing-Wen]] among the first Taiwanese to receive a dose of the [[protein subunit]] vaccine. [https://asia.nikkei.com/Spotlight/Coronavirus/COVID-vaccines/Taiwan-begins-contested-rollout-of-new-Medigen-domestic-vaccine (''Nikkei Asia'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Vietnam]]
****[[Vietnam]] imposes their toughest [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] in [[Ho Chi Minh City]], prohibiting people from leaving their homes and also deploying the [[People's Army of Vietnam|Vietnamese People's Army]] in order to enforce the lockdown in the country's largest city amid an increase in the number of COVID-19 infections and deaths. [https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2021-08-23/vietnam-deploys-troops-to-enforce-lockdown-in-largest-city?context=amp (''U.S. News & World Report'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New South Wales]] 
*****[[New South Wales]] imposes a 9:00 p.m. to 5:00 a.m. [[curfew]] in 12 [[Local government areas of New South Wales|LGA]]s of concern in [[Sydney|Greater Sydney]], limiting exercise to one hour in hotspot areas and mandating statewide outdoor [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic|mask wearing]] as the number of COVID-19 cases continues to remain high. [https://www.9news.com.au/national/coronavirus-nsw-lockdown-restrictions-update-greater-sydney-lockdown-extended-new-restrictions-curfew-explainer/8d6732e0-7e77-4d77-9eac-e05d31e75df8 (''Nine News'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in French Polynesia]]
****The [[French overseas department]] of [[French Polynesia]] closes all [[school]]s and tightens its [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] for two weeks amid an increase in the number of COVID-19 cases caused by the [[SARS-CoV-2 Delta variant|Delta variant]]. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20210821-covid-19-french-polynesia-closes-schools-tightens-lockdown-for-two-weeks (Radio France Internationale)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand]]
****[[New Zealand]] extends its level 4 [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] until August 31 in [[Auckland]] and August 27 in the rest of the country as the number of cases related to the Delta variant outbreak reaches 100. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/aug/23/new-zealand-covid-cases-outbreak-lockdown (''The Guardian'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]] 
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Belarus]]
****[[Belarus]] will receive $1 billion from the [[International Monetary Fund]] to help fight the COVID-19 outbreak in the country. [https://www.politico.eu/article/imf-awards-belarus-one-billion-fight-covid/ (''Politico Europe'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]]
****[[Germany]] drops incidence levels from its yardstick for deciding if restrictions should be in force to contain the spread of COVID-19 as more people are vaccinated. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/german-drop-incidence-levels-key-covid-yardstick-sources-2021-08-23/ (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[United Kingdom]] signs an agreement with [[Pfizer]] to secure 35 million doses of the [[Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine]] due to be delivered in the second half of 2022 as the [[Government of the United Kingdom|government]] focuses on a "future-proof vaccine programme" to prevent any virus variants that are resistant to the vaccine. [https://www.bbc.com/news/health-58307215.amp (BBC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 vaccination in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Jersey]]
*****[[Governor of New Jersey|New Jersey Governor]] [[Phil Murphy]] announces that [[New Jersey]] will require teachers to receive a [[COVID-19 vaccine]] by October 18 or face mandatory [[COVID-19 testing]]. [https://www.thecentersquare.com/new_jersey/murphy-announces-vaccination-mandate-for-new-jersey-teachers-state-employees/article_882e9f40-0454-11ec-8c1f-5bec0f7dc5f2.html (''The Center Square'')]
****The [[Food and Drug Administration]] gives full approval to the [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine]], becoming the first vaccine in the [[United States|U.S.]] to be granted full licensure and thereby giving businesses, schools and universities more confidence to adopt vaccine mandates. [https://www.cnbc.com/2021/08/23/fda-pfizer-biontech-covid-vaccine-wins-full-approval-clearing-path-to-mandates.html (CNBC)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Arizona]]
****[[Arizona Senate]] president [[Karen Fann]] announces that the delivery of the draft report from [[Cyber Ninjas]], the company leading an [[2021 Maricopa County presidential ballot audit|audit]] of [[Maricopa County, Arizona|Maricopa County]]'s [[2020 United States presidential election in Arizona|presidential election]], has been delayed after [[Chief executive officer|CEO]] Doug Logan and two other members have tested positive for [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2020-election/delivery-full-arizona-audit-report-delayed-after-cyber-ninjas-test-n1277474 (NBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Florida]]
****[[Palm Beach County, Florida|Palm Beach County]] announces that fans will be required to wear masks at athletic events amidst a cancellation of high school events in the county. [https://www.palmbeachpost.com/story/sports/high-school/football/2021/08/23/palm-beach-county-school-district-new-protocols-high-school-sports/8251104002/ (''The Palm Beach Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Washington (state)|COVID-19 pandemic in Washington]]
****[[Washington (state)|Washington]] reimposes its indoor [[Face masks during the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|mask mandate]], requiring people over the age of 5 to wear masks in indoor public spaces regardless of their vaccination status. [https://patch.com/washington/seattle/statewide-indoor-mask-order-returns-monday-washington (Patch)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Argentina]]
***The patient zero of the [[SARS-CoV-2 lineage B.1.617|Delta variant]] in [[Argentina]], a 62-year-old Peruvian national, dies from the disease. The man had been indicted while hospitalized with multiple crimes related to him not informing the authorities about his symptoms, breaching quarantine, entering the country unvaccinated and infecting 13 other people. [https://marketresearchtelecast.com/first-death-due-to-the-delta-variant-in-argentina-patient-zero-dies-in-cordoba/136795/ (Market Research Telecast)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Egypt]]
***[[Egypt]] reports its first case of the Delta Plus variant in a 35-year-old Egyptian woman who had shown "very mild" symptoms in July. [https://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/1/64/419627/Egypt/Politics-/Egypt-detected-its-first-case-of-the-Delta-Plus-va.aspx (''Al-Ahram'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[2021 Belarus–European Union border crisis]], [[Belarus–Poland relations]]
**[[Poland]] announces that it will build a wall on [[Belarus–Poland border|its border with Belarus]] in order to stop the flow of migrants entering the country through [[Belarus]]. [https://www.euronews.com/2021/08/23/poland-will-build-a-fence-on-its-border-with-belarus-to-stop-migrants (Euronews)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Protests over responses to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in London]]
***[[Anti-vax movement|Anti-vax protesters]] storm the [[ITN]] headquarters in [[London]], [[United Kingdom]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/home-news/anti-vax-protesters-itn-studios-today-b1907161.html (''The Independent'')]
*[[Proud Boys]] leader [[Enrique Tarrio]] is sentenced to more than five months in prison after admitting to burning a [[Black Lives Matter]] banner from a Black church during a pro-Trump rally on [[2020–21 United States election protests#December 12|December 12]] of last year. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/proud-boys-leader-sentenced-more-5-months-burning-black-lives-n1277466 (NBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 New Caledonian independence referendum]]
**[[New Caledonia]]'s pro- and anti-independence camps formally launch their campaigns ahead of a [[independence referendum|referendum]] on independence from [[France]] in December. [https://postcourier.com.pg/new-caledonia-launches-independence-referendum-campaigns/ (''Papua New Guinea Post-Courier'')]
*[[2021 Tunisian political crisis]]
**[[President of Tunisia|Tunisian president]] [[Kais Saied]] extends the suspension of the [[Assembly of the Representatives of the People]]'s activity ''sine die'' as well as lawmakers' immunity. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/tunisias-president-extends-suspension-parliament-2021-08-23/ (Reuters)]
